title: Kossin and Karn in Illustration Magazine
content: Illustration Magazine comes out every three months with gorgeous color features on twentieth century illustrators.The new Issue 25 takes a look at the pulp and fashion work of Gloria Stoll Karn and the bold designs of Sandy Kossin.Kossin himself wrote the second article, which includes 41 illustrations. He looks back on a career that included everything from children's magazines and movie posters to visualizations of the Bay of Pigs invasion for LIFE magazine.------Illustration Magazine website,link.
